SUMMARY.md: A magical JSON API for Harry Potter characters, spells, and the wizarding world. API providing data on Harry Potter characters and spells. Includes routes for all characters, specific character by ID, Hogwarts students and staff, characters in a house, and all spells.
Ancestry of the character (for example, pure-blood, half-blood, muggle-born)
Date of birth of the character
Description of what the spell does
Name of the actor who portrayed the character
Successful response with all staff members
Successful response with characters from the specified house
